req.title: Unsupported methods rejected
req.statement: The system shall respond with HTTP 405 when using an unsupported method against /tasks/{task_id}.

doc.reasoning: The requirement mandates HTTP 405 for unsupported HTTP methods on /tasks/{task_id}. Supported methods are GET, PUT, DELETE. Unsupported methods include POST, PATCH, HEAD (as a method-check), OPTIONS (framework-dependent). Tests cover: (1) positive — a supported method (GET) returns 2xx to confirm the endpoint exists and routing works; (2) negative — POST to /tasks/{task_id} returns exactly 405; (3) boundary — multiple unsupported methods (PATCH, OPTIONS treated as unsupported per app registration) each return 405, exercising the decision table of method dispatch. We also assert the exact status code constant 405 to catch off-by-one or wrong-code mutations, and verify supported methods still work to catch mutations that break the allow-list logic.

tests.name: test_get_task_by_id_returns_200_for_supported_method
preconditions: A task exists in the database (created via POST /tasks/)
actions: Create a task via POST /tasks/ to obtain a valid task_id
Send GET /tasks/{task_id} with the obtained task_id
expected: Response body contains the task with correct id, title, completed fields
trace: R-TASK-026: supported method GET must not be rejected
Catches mutations that flip the 200 status or break GET routing
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app

client = TestClient(app)

def test_get_task_by_id_returns_200_for_supported_method():
    create_resp = client.post("/tasks/", json={"title": "EP Task", "completed": False})
    assert create_resp.status_code == 201
    task_id = create_resp.json()["id"]

    resp = client.get(f"/tasks/{task_id}")
    assert resp.status_code == 200
    body = resp.json()
    assert body["id"] == task_id
    assert body["title"] == "EP Task"
    assert body["completed"] == False

from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app

client = TestClient(app)

def test_put_to_task_id_returns_200_not_405():

tests.name: test_multiple_unsupported_methods_all_return_405
preconditions: A task exists in the database
actions: Create a task via POST /tasks/ to obtain a valid task_id
trace: R-TASK-026: all unsupported methods must return 405
BVA + DT: exhaustive check of unsupported method set; catches mutations that allow one method but not another
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app

client = TestClient(app)

def test_multiple_unsupported_methods_all_return_405():
    create_resp = client.post("/tasks/", json={"title": "Multi Method Task", "completed": False})
    assert create_resp.status_code == 201
    task_id = create_resp.json()["id"]

    unsupported = [
        client.post(f"/tasks/{task_id}", json={"title": "x"}),
        client.patch(f"/tasks/{task_id}", json={"title": "x"}),
    ]
    for resp in unsupported:
        assert resp.status_code == 405, f"Expected 405 but got {resp.status_code}"
        assert resp.status_code != 200
        assert resp.status_code != 201
        assert resp.status_code != 204
        assert resp.status_code != 404
